description: Gares et stations du réseau ferré d'Île-de-France (par ligne) is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant, par ligne, les gares de Train et de RER, les stations de métro, de tramways, de val et de funiculaire ouvertes aux voyageurs en Île-de-France. Généalogie de la donnée Donnée communiquée par les transporteurs et recalée sur la photo aérienne lorsque la gare n'est pas souterraine. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Train, Métro, Tramway, Transports en commun, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 1,240 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
